title: Marketing Analytics
text:
Throughout this course, I completed a variety of marketing analytics projects using industry tools and data-driven techniques. These projects demonstrate my ability to collect, analyze, visualize, and communicate marketing insights to support strategic business decisions.
Using R, Quarto, Google Analytics 4, Power BI, and Microsoft Excel, I explored customer behavior, website performance, data visualization, and digital marketing analytics. Each project strengthened my analytical skills while improving my ability to present findings in a clear and professional manner.

title: Marketing Analytics
text:
Featured Projects

Google Analytics 4 (GA4): Explored website traffic, user behavior, funnels, and key performance indicators using GA4.
Data Visualization with R: Created charts and visualizations using ggplot2 to communicate trends and insights from real datasets.
Marketing Dashboards: Built interactive dashboards to summarize marketing performance and support business decisions.
Quarto Website Development: Designed and published professional reports and websites using Quarto and GitHub.
Marketing Analytics Applications: Applied analytical techniques to evaluate marketing performance and develop data-driven recommendations.


Below are examples of the projects I completed throughout the semester.

title: Strategic Marketing
text: Throughout my coursework in marketing and business strategy, I completed projects that strengthened my ability to develop marketing strategies, analyze competitive environments, and make data-driven business decisions. These projects demonstrate my understanding of consumer behavior, strategic planning, digital marketing, and marketing communications.

title: Strategic Marketing
text:
Nintendo Marketing Campaign
For this group project, my team developed an integrated marketing campaign for the Nintendo Switch. We identified a target audience, selected advertising objectives, created promotional materials, and developed recommendations using consumer behavior and marketing communication principles.

title: Strategic Marketing

Business Strategy Simulation (Capsim)
Using the Capsim business simulation, I managed a virtual company’s marketing, production, finance, and research & development decisions. Throughout multiple simulation rounds, I analyzed market conditions, adjusted pricing and production strategies, and evaluated financial performance to improve overall company results.

title: Google Analytics 4 Funnel Exploration
text:
Overview
This project used Google Analytics 4 Funnel Exploration to analyze the customer journey from initial website visits to key conversion events. By identifying where users exited the funnel, I evaluated opportunities to improve the user experience and increase conversion rates.




Learning Outcomes

Build and analyze GA4 Funnel Explorations.
Identify user drop-off points within the conversion funnel.
Evaluate website performance using conversion metrics.
Recommend improvements to increase user engagement.
Present findings using visual reports.
